canonicalServices.title: Air Conditioning
canonicalServices.summary: Air conditioning help can cover a new split or ducted system, a poorly performing unit, servicing needs or replacement advice for a home or managed property.
commonTasks: Assess the room layout, existing system and suitable unit type
Install or replace indoor and outdoor equipment where the scope permits
Investigate weak airflow, unusual noise, leaks or temperature problems
customerInfo: Property type, room sizes and the areas that need heating or cooling
Photos and model details of any existing indoor and outdoor units
Switchboard location, outdoor-unit access and preferred outcome
canonicalServices.safetyNote: Electrical connections and refrigerant work may require appropriately licensed providers; isolate a unit that is sparking, smoking or visibly damaged and avoid touching it.
canonicalServices.nextStep: Send the system type, affected rooms and suburb so Ellis can arrange the right air-conditioning pathway.

canonicalServices.title: Blinds & Curtains
canonicalServices.summary: Blind and curtain services cover measuring, fitting and repairing common window furnishings, from roller blinds to tracks, rods and curtain systems.
commonTasks: Measure windows for suitable blinds, curtains, tracks or rods
Fit supplied window furnishings and mounting hardware
Repair loose brackets, damaged cords, tracks or operating mechanisms
customerInfo: Window measurements, wall material and number of openings
Photos showing frames, existing brackets and nearby obstructions
Product details and whether items are supplied or need sourcing
canonicalServices.safetyNote: Corded window coverings can present a child-strangulation risk and should comply with current safety requirements; high or difficult access also needs suitable controls.
canonicalServices.nextStep: Share photos, measurements and the product style to help Ellis scope the window-furnishing work.

canonicalServices.title: Carpenters
canonicalServices.summary: Carpentry enquiries can include timber repairs, internal fit-out, framing adjustments and made-to-fit features around the home.
commonTasks: Repair or replace damaged timber trim, doors, frames and skirting
Build shelving, storage or other fitted timber elements
Complete scoped framing, lining or finishing carpentry
customerInfo: Photos and dimensions of the item or area
Timber species, finish or matching requirements if known
Any signs of rot, movement, termites or water damage
canonicalServices.safetyNote: Structural alterations, load-bearing work and tasks near concealed services may need engineering, approvals or appropriately qualified trades.
canonicalServices.nextStep: Provide dimensions, close-up photos and the intended finish so Ellis can identify the appropriate carpentry response.

canonicalServices.title: Carpet Repair
canonicalServices.summary: Carpet repair focuses on localised damage, loose edges, wrinkles, joins and small areas affected by wear, stains or burns.
commonTasks: Re-stretch loose or rippled carpet
Patch damaged sections using a compatible donor piece
Repair joins, edges, transitions or lifting around doorways
customerInfo: Photos of the damage and the overall room
Carpet type, age and whether matching offcuts are available
Approximate affected dimensions and any moisture history
canonicalServices.safetyNote: Moisture, mould or contaminated flooring should be assessed before cosmetic repair; do not lift material where hidden electrical or hazardous-material risks may exist.
canonicalServices.nextStep: Send a wide photo, a close-up and the damaged area size for a carpet-repair assessment.

canonicalServices.title: Cladding
canonicalServices.summary: Cladding work can address damaged exterior boards or panels, localised weather exposure, replacement sections and new wall-finish enquiries.
commonTasks: Inspect visible deterioration, gaps, loose sections or failed junctions
Replace compatible cladding boards or panels within an agreed scope
Detail corners, openings and flashings as part of an exterior envelope job
customerInfo: Building type, wall elevation and approximate affected area
Photos of the cladding profile, damage and nearby roof or window junctions
Known material type, age and access constraints
canonicalServices.safetyNote: Some older cladding may contain hazardous materials, while height and weatherproofing work require specialist controls; do not disturb suspect products.
canonicalServices.nextStep: Upload elevation and close-up photos so Ellis can route the cladding enquiry appropriately.

canonicalServices.title: Electricians
canonicalServices.summary: Electrical services cover faults, fittings, power points, lighting, switchboards and electrical work associated with renovations or appliances.
commonTasks: Diagnose tripping circuits, loss of power or faulty fittings
Install or replace lights, switches, power points and hard-wired equipment
Assess switchboards, safety switches and renovation electrical requirements
customerInfo: What stopped working, when it began and whether circuits are tripping
Photos of the fitting, switchboard labels or equipment model where safe
Property age, access details and the rooms or circuits involved
canonicalServices.safetyNote: Electrical work must be handled by an appropriately licensed electrician where required. Keep clear of exposed wires, heat, smoke, sparks or wet electrical equipment and use emergency services for immediate danger.
canonicalServices.nextStep: Tell Ellis the symptoms, affected circuit or fitting, and location to arrange an appropriate electrical assessment.

canonicalServices.title: Floor Sanding
canonicalServices.summary: Floor sanding can restore suitable timber floors by removing worn coatings, smoothing boards and preparing the surface for a chosen finish.
commonTasks: Assess timber condition, coating build-up and board movement
Sand accessible timber floors and edges to an agreed level
Apply a compatible coating system after colour and sheen selection
customerInfo: Room dimensions and clear photos in natural light
Timber type and existing coating if known
Stains, protruding nails, loose boards, furniture and access constraints
canonicalServices.safetyNote: Old coatings, dust and unknown floor materials can require special controls; occupied areas need isolation and adequate ventilation during the work.
canonicalServices.nextStep: Share room sizes, timber photos and finish preferences for a floor-sanding scope.

canonicalServices.title: Fly Screens & Repairs
canonicalServices.summary: Fly-screen services cover new mesh screens, remeshing, frame repairs and adjustments to fixed, sliding or hinged screen units.
commonTasks: Remesh torn or brittle insect screens
Repair or replace damaged frames, corners, rollers and handles
Measure and fit screens for compatible windows or doors
customerInfo: Opening dimensions and screen type
Photos of the full frame, track and damaged area
Preferred mesh type and whether pets or coastal exposure are considerations
canonicalServices.safetyNote: Screens on upper levels or difficult external openings require safe access; security-screen work may have product-specific installation requirements.
canonicalServices.nextStep: Send frame measurements and photos of the opening so Ellis can scope the fly-screen solution.

canonicalServices.title: Insulation
canonicalServices.summary: Insulation enquiries can cover roof, ceiling, wall or underfloor upgrades, missing sections and comfort or energy-performance concerns.
commonTasks: Inspect accessible insulation coverage and condition
Install suitable bulk or reflective insulation to the agreed area
Address gaps around penetrations while maintaining required clearances
customerInfo: Area to be insulated and property construction type
Roof-space, underfloor or wall access details
Any moisture, pest, wiring or existing-insulation concerns
canonicalServices.safetyNote: Roof spaces can contain heat, electrical, asbestos and access hazards. Electrical clearances and installation requirements should be handled by appropriately qualified providers.
canonicalServices.nextStep: Provide the property type, target area and access details for an insulation assessment.

canonicalServices.title: New Carpet
canonicalServices.summary: New-carpet services cover measuring, product selection support, removal planning and installation across bedrooms, living areas or managed properties.
commonTasks: Measure rooms, stairs and transitions for carpet quantities
Prepare for underlay and carpet installation over suitable substrates
Install carpet, joins, edges and transition trims to the agreed layout
customerInfo: Floor plan or room measurements and photos
Preferred fibre, colour, pile and use requirements
Existing flooring, furniture, access and disposal needs
canonicalServices.safetyNote: Subfloor moisture, damaged substrates or suspect legacy materials must be assessed before removal or installation proceeds.
canonicalServices.nextStep: Share room dimensions, use requirements and flooring photos to start a carpet-installation scope.

canonicalServices.title: Plasterers
canonicalServices.summary: Plastering covers wall and ceiling repairs, new linings, joints, cornices and surfaces that need preparation before decorating.
commonTasks: Patch holes, impact damage and localised ceiling defects
Install plasterboard and finish joints for scoped alterations
Repair or replace cornice and prepare surfaces for painting
customerInfo: Photos with an object for scale and the affected dimensions
Whether damage is on a wall, ceiling, wet area or external surface
Any leak, movement, cracking or previous repair history
canonicalServices.safetyNote: Active leaks, structural movement and suspect asbestos-containing materials must be resolved or assessed before plaster is disturbed.
canonicalServices.nextStep: Send clear photos and explain what caused the damage so Ellis can match the plastering scope.

canonicalServices.title: Plumbers
canonicalServices.summary: Plumbing services can address leaks, blocked fixtures, taps, toilets, pipework and water connections associated with repairs or upgrades.
commonTasks: Locate and repair leaking accessible pipework or fixtures
Clear suitable blocked sinks, toilets or drains after assessment
Install or replace taps, toilets and plumbing-connected fixtures
customerInfo: Where the problem appears and which fixtures are affected
When it started, whether water can be isolated and any visible damage
Photos, fixture details and access to meters, valves or drains
canonicalServices.safetyNote: Plumbing work may require an appropriately licensed provider. For uncontrolled water, isolate the supply only if safe and keep clear of electrical equipment or contaminated overflow.
canonicalServices.nextStep: Describe the affected fixture, symptoms and suburb so Ellis can arrange the suitable plumbing pathway.

canonicalServices.title: Shower Screens
canonicalServices.summary: Shower-screen work includes measuring, installation, adjustment and replacement of framed, semi-frameless or frameless enclosures.
commonTasks: Measure the shower opening and check wall and floor conditions
Install a suitable screen, door and hardware system
Adjust hinges, rollers, seals and alignment on serviceable screens
customerInfo: Opening measurements and bathroom photos
Screen style, glass configuration and hardware finish preferences
Leaks, loose panels, cracked glass or wall-fixing concerns
canonicalServices.safetyNote: Cracked or unstable toughened glass should not be handled. Glazing, drilling and wet-area penetrations require suitable methods and qualified providers where applicable.
canonicalServices.nextStep: Share full shower photos, approximate dimensions and the issue to scope the screen work.

canonicalServices.title: Tiling
canonicalServices.summary: Tiling enquiries can cover new wall or floor finishes, replacement of damaged tiles, regrouting and preparation of suitable substrates.
commonTasks: Lay wall or floor tiles to an agreed pattern and finish
Replace localised cracked or loose tiles where a compatible match exists
Renew grout or sealant after checking the underlying condition
customerInfo: Area dimensions, tile size and layout preference
Photos of the substrate, damage, corners and penetrations
Whether tiles are supplied and any known waterproofing or movement issue
canonicalServices.safetyNote: Loose tiles, persistent moisture or cracking may indicate substrate or waterproofing problems that need assessment before cosmetic work.
canonicalServices.nextStep: Provide dimensions, tile details and photos of the whole area for a tiling scope.

canonicalServices.title: Waterproofing
canonicalServices.summary: Waterproofing services address membranes and junction detailing in bathrooms, balconies and other wet areas as part of an appropriately prepared project.
commonTasks: Assess the proposed wet area and substrate condition
Apply a compatible membrane system to the specified zones
Detail corners, penetrations, wastes and upturns before finishes are installed
customerInfo: Plans or dimensions and the wet-area location
Photos of the prepared substrate and all penetrations
Any leak history, existing finishes and downstream damage
canonicalServices.safetyNote: Waterproofing may require licensed or otherwise qualified providers and must integrate with drainage, substrate and relevant building requirements; active leaks need proper diagnosis.
canonicalServices.nextStep: Send the wet-area layout, substrate photos and project stage so Ellis can arrange the right assessment.

canonicalServices.title: Asbestos Removal
canonicalServices.summary: Asbestos-removal enquiries require controlled assessment and, where confirmed, compliant removal and disposal by providers authorised for the material and job type.
commonTasks: Arrange identification or sampling through a competent asbestos professional
Prepare a removal scope with isolation, controls and clearance needs
Remove and dispose of confirmed asbestos-containing material through authorised channels
customerInfo: Material location, approximate area and current condition
Building age, renovation history and any existing laboratory report
Photos taken without touching the material, plus occupancy and access details
canonicalServices.safetyNote: Do not cut, drill, sand, break, sweep or vacuum suspected asbestos. Keep people away from damaged material and use appropriately licensed removalists where required by the material, quantity and jurisdiction.
canonicalServices.nextStep: Leave suspect material undisturbed and contact Ellis with the location and any existing report for specialist routing.

canonicalServices.title: Concrete Resurfacing
canonicalServices.summary: Concrete resurfacing refreshes a sound slab or paved area with a compatible coating or overlay after condition and preparation checks.
commonTasks: Assess cracking, contamination, moisture and existing coatings
Prepare the surface by suitable cleaning or mechanical methods
Apply a selected resurfacing system and finish to the agreed area
customerInfo: Area dimensions, use and desired appearance
Photos of cracks, stains, drainage and transitions
Existing coating details, vehicle loads and access timing
canonicalServices.safetyNote: Moving slabs, major structural cracks, moisture or chemical contamination may rule out a cosmetic overlay until the cause is assessed.
canonicalServices.nextStep: Share area measurements and condition photos to determine whether resurfacing is suitable.

canonicalServices.title: Gutter Services
canonicalServices.summary: Gutter services bring cleaning, repair and replacement under one pathway for gutters and downpipes that are blocked, leaking, rusted, loose or poorly draining.
commonTasks: Remove accessible leaf build-up and check outlets for blockages
Repair leaking joins, loose brackets and localised damaged sections
Replace deteriorated gutters or downpipes and review falls and discharge points
customerInfo: Building height, roof type and safe access points
Photos of overflow locations, rust, sagging and downpipe connections
Whether the issue occurs in light rain, heavy rain or remains constant
canonicalServices.safetyNote: Roof-edge work involves fall and electrical-clearance risks. Do not climb onto a wet or unsuitable roof; stormwater changes may also need to meet local requirements.
canonicalServices.nextStep: Send exterior photos and note where water overflows so Ellis can distinguish cleaning, repair or replacement needs.

canonicalServices.title: House Painters
canonicalServices.summary: House painting can cover interior rooms, exterior surfaces, trims and repainting programs after preparation and coating compatibility are assessed.
commonTasks: Prepare surfaces by cleaning, filling and sanding where suitable
Apply compatible primers and finish coats to agreed areas
Paint walls, ceilings, trims or exterior elements to the selected scheme
customerInfo: Rooms or elevations, dimensions and current surface condition
Colour, sheen and product preferences if selected
Access, furniture, peeling paint, moisture or previous coating concerns
canonicalServices.safetyNote: Older coatings may contain lead, and height or deteriorated surfaces require appropriate testing and controls before preparation.
canonicalServices.nextStep: Provide photos, approximate areas and colour intentions for a painting scope.

canonicalServices.title: Door Installation
canonicalServices.summary: Door-installation services cover internal and external doors, frames, hinges, hardware and adjustments needed for a secure, smooth fit.
commonTasks: Measure the opening and check frame condition and clearances
Fit a compatible hinged, sliding or cavity door system
Install or adjust hinges, handles, locks, closers and weather seals
customerInfo: Opening width, height, wall thickness and door location
Photos of the frame, threshold, swing area and existing hardware
Door type, material, fire or security requirements if known
canonicalServices.safetyNote: Entry, fire-rated, security and glazed doors can have specific product, fixing and compliance requirements; lock work may need a suitable specialist.
canonicalServices.nextStep: Send opening measurements, frame photos and the preferred door type for accurate routing.

canonicalServices.title: Pavers
canonicalServices.summary: Paving services cover new paths and outdoor areas, lifted or sunken sections, edging and repairs where the base and drainage are suitable.
commonTasks: Prepare or repair the base for a stable paved surface
Lay pavers to the chosen pattern, level and edge restraint
Lift and relay localised uneven sections after investigating the cause
customerInfo: Area dimensions, intended use and paver preference
Photos showing levels, drainage points and adjoining surfaces
Access for materials, existing base and any tree-root or settlement issue
canonicalServices.safetyNote: Uneven paving may reflect drainage, roots or ground movement; service locations should be checked before excavation.
canonicalServices.nextStep: Share measurements, level photos and intended use to scope the paving work.

canonicalServices.title: Roofing & Roof Repairs
canonicalServices.summary: Roofing enquiries include leak investigation, damaged tiles or sheets, flashings, roof penetrations and larger repair or replacement scopes.
commonTasks: Inspect accessible roof coverings, ridges, flashings and penetrations
Repair or replace damaged tiles, sheets or localised components
Trace likely water-entry paths and address agreed roof defects
customerInfo: Roof material, building height and approximate age
Photos from ground level and where internal staining appears
When leaks occur, previous repairs and safe access information
canonicalServices.safetyNote: Roof access carries fall, fragile-surface and electrical risks. Do not climb during wet or windy conditions; significant storm damage or live electrical hazards require an urgent specialist response.
canonicalServices.nextStep: Provide roof type, leak timing and safe-to-take photos so Ellis can route the roofing assessment.

canonicalServices.title: Skylights
canonicalServices.summary: Skylight services can cover new units, replacements, leaking junctions and ventilation or light improvements in suitable roof locations.
commonTasks: Assess roof type, ceiling layout and proposed skylight position
Install or replace compatible skylight and flashing components
Investigate leaks, condensation or failed seals around an existing unit
customerInfo: Roof and ceiling photos, room location and roof material
Existing unit brand, dimensions and opening style if available
Leak timing, access conditions and desired light or ventilation outcome
canonicalServices.safetyNote: Roof penetrations involve fall and weatherproofing risks; electrical blinds or nearby wiring may require an appropriately licensed electrician.
canonicalServices.nextStep: Send room and roof photos with the skylight dimensions or desired location for assessment.

canonicalServices.title: Verandah Builders
canonicalServices.summary: Verandah projects can range from replacing components to planning a new covered outdoor area connected to a home.
commonTasks: Develop the footprint, roof form and connection details for a verandah
Construct framing, roofing, posts and selected finishes to an approved scope
Repair deteriorated boards, roof sheets or structural elements after assessment
customerInfo: Site dimensions, photos and preferred footprint
House construction, roof relationship and drainage considerations
Desired materials, use and any plans or approvals already held
canonicalServices.safetyNote: Structural connections, footings, permits, boundaries and stormwater can require design, approval and appropriately qualified providers.
canonicalServices.nextStep: Share the site layout, proposed size and any existing documents to begin a verandah assessment.

canonicalServices.title: Window Installation
canonicalServices.summary: Window installation covers measuring and fitting replacement or new window units while addressing openings, flashings, seals and finishes.
commonTasks: Measure the structural opening and select a compatible window configuration
Remove and replace an existing unit within an agreed scope
Install flashings, seals and trims appropriate to the wall system
customerInfo: Opening measurements, wall construction and storey level
Photos inside and outside, including sills and surrounding finishes
Frame material, glazing, opening style and performance preferences
canonicalServices.safetyNote: Glazing, upper-storey access and changes to structural openings require specialist controls; energy, bushfire or heritage requirements may affect product selection.
canonicalServices.nextStep: Provide inside and outside photos plus approximate opening sizes for a window-installation pathway.

canonicalServices.title: Window Repairs
canonicalServices.summary: Window repair addresses sticking sashes, failed rollers, damaged hardware, draughts, seals and localised frame defects where the unit remains serviceable.
commonTasks: Adjust or repair hinges, stays, rollers, locks and balances
Replace suitable seals, catches or other worn window hardware
Repair localised frame or sill damage after identifying moisture sources
customerInfo: Window style, material and approximate age
Photos of the full window, hardware and damaged area
How operation has changed and whether water entry is present
canonicalServices.safetyNote: Cracked glass and upper-level external work should not be handled without suitable glazing and access controls; frame rot may indicate a wider moisture issue.
canonicalServices.nextStep: Send photos of the window open and closed, plus the operating problem, for repair triage.

canonicalServices.title: Deck Builders
canonicalServices.summary: Deck services can include new timber or composite platforms, board replacement, stairs, balustrades and refurbishment of an existing deck.
commonTasks: Plan deck dimensions, levels, materials and connection points
Build framing, decking, stairs and edge details to an agreed scope
Replace deteriorated boards or components after checking the supporting structure
customerInfo: Site measurements, height above ground and intended use
Photos of access, ground conditions and the house connection
Material preference and any existing drawings or approvals
canonicalServices.safetyNote: Elevated decks, balustrades, footings and structural connections may require approvals, engineering and appropriately qualified builders.
canonicalServices.nextStep: Share the proposed size, height and site photos so Ellis can identify the deck project pathway.

canonicalServices.title: Fence Builders
canonicalServices.summary: Fence-building enquiries cover new boundary or internal fences, replacement runs, gates and common materials such as timber, metal or composite systems.
commonTasks: Measure the fence line and confirm levels and access
Install posts, rails, panels and gates to the selected system
Replace a failed fence run after reviewing footings and ground conditions
customerInfo: Fence length, height, material and gate requirements
Photos of boundaries, slopes, retaining walls and access
Any neighbour agreement, survey information or existing fence issues
canonicalServices.safetyNote: Boundary position, pool proximity, retaining loads, underground services and local rules may affect the work; do not assume an existing fence marks the legal boundary.
canonicalServices.nextStep: Send fence-line photos, dimensions and material preference to scope a new or replacement fence.

canonicalServices.title: Fencing Contractors
canonicalServices.summary: Fencing contractors can coordinate larger, mixed-material or site-specific fencing packages for homes, strata and managed properties.
commonTasks: Assess a multi-section fence layout and performance needs
Deliver replacement, security or screening fencing to a defined specification
Coordinate gates, access points and interfaces with walls or landscaping
customerInfo: Site plan, total lengths, heights and fence purpose
Material or performance specification and gate schedule
Boundary, access, ground condition and staging information
canonicalServices.safetyNote: Projects near boundaries, pools, retaining walls or services may require surveys, approvals and specialist design.
canonicalServices.nextStep: Provide the fence schedule or marked-up site plan so Ellis can route the contractor enquiry.

canonicalServices.title: Garden Clean Up
canonicalServices.summary: Garden clean-up helps restore overgrown or untidy outdoor areas through a defined mix of cutting back, clearing and green-waste handling.
commonTasks: Cut back manageable overgrowth and remove spent plant material
Weed and tidy garden beds, paths and accessible edges
Collect and coordinate disposal of agreed green waste
customerInfo: Property size and photos of each work zone
Vegetation height, waste volume and access width
Known sharp waste, pests, unstable branches or restricted areas
canonicalServices.safetyNote: Large trees, overhead services, hazardous waste and potentially asbestos-containing debris need specialist assessment rather than routine clean-up.
canonicalServices.nextStep: Send zone photos and access details so Ellis can estimate the clean-up scope and waste needs.

canonicalServices.title: Garden Landscapers
canonicalServices.summary: Garden landscaping covers planned changes to planting, beds, edging and outdoor layout rather than routine mowing alone.
commonTasks: Develop a practical planting and soft-landscape layout
Prepare beds, improve soil and install selected plants or mulch
Add garden edging and coordinate compatible minor landscape elements
customerInfo: Site dimensions, sun, soil and drainage observations
Photos and the preferred style or maintenance level
Plants or materials to retain, access and water availability
canonicalServices.safetyNote: Excavation should account for underground services, drainage and retaining needs; significant structures or level changes may require specialist design.
canonicalServices.nextStep: Share site photos, dimensions and the desired garden character for a landscaping assessment.

canonicalServices.title: Gardeners
canonicalServices.summary: Gardening services support recurring or one-off care of established lawns, garden beds, shrubs and small plants.
commonTasks: Weed, prune and maintain garden beds within a defined visit
Shape manageable shrubs and remove spent growth
Refresh mulch and complete seasonal planting or general garden care
customerInfo: Garden size, photos and desired visit frequency
Priority plants or zones and the current maintenance issue
Green-waste expectations, pets, gates and water access
canonicalServices.safetyNote: Tall trees, powerline clearance, chemicals and heavy or unstable branches require suitable specialist controls.
canonicalServices.nextStep: Describe the garden zones, priorities and preferred frequency so Ellis can match the maintenance request.

canonicalServices.title: Lawn Mowing
canonicalServices.summary: Lawn mowing covers routine cutting, edging and presentation of accessible residential or managed-property lawn areas.
commonTasks: Mow lawns to an appropriate height for the turf and season
Edge paths, garden borders and accessible fixed features
Collect or mulch clippings according to the agreed service
customerInfo: Approximate lawn area, slope and current grass height
Photos of front, rear and side access
Preferred frequency, green-bin access and any obstacles
canonicalServices.safetyNote: Hidden debris, steep slopes, pets and irrigation components should be identified before powered equipment is used.
canonicalServices.nextStep: Send lawn photos, approximate size and access width to arrange a mowing scope.

canonicalServices.title: Patio Builders
canonicalServices.summary: Patio-building services address paved or decked outdoor living areas, including layout, base preparation, drainage and selected finishes.
commonTasks: Set out a patio footprint that works with doors, levels and drainage
Prepare a suitable base and install the selected surface system
Coordinate edges, steps and transitions with adjoining landscape elements
customerInfo: Dimensions, current surface and intended furniture or use
Photos of levels, drainage, door thresholds and access
Preferred paving, concrete or decking finish and any existing plans
canonicalServices.safetyNote: Excavation, drainage, structural covers and work near boundaries may need approvals or specialist input.
canonicalServices.nextStep: Share the proposed footprint, levels and material preference for a patio project assessment.

canonicalServices.title: Pergola Builders
canonicalServices.summary: Pergola enquiries cover freestanding or attached shade structures, from open battens to roofed designs where permitted.
commonTasks: Plan dimensions, post positions and the desired shade or roof form
Construct the approved frame, connections and selected covering
Repair scoped deterioration after the structure is assessed
customerInfo: Site measurements and photos of the proposed location
Whether the structure is attached, freestanding, open or roofed
Material preference, drainage needs and existing approvals
canonicalServices.safetyNote: Footings, structural connections, wind exposure, boundaries and roofing can trigger engineering or approval requirements.
canonicalServices.nextStep: Provide site dimensions and the preferred pergola form so Ellis can determine the right design and build pathway.

canonicalServices.title: Pool Fence Installers
canonicalServices.summary: Pool-fence services focus on compliant barrier layouts, gates and repairs intended to maintain safe separation around a pool area.
commonTasks: Measure and install a suitable pool-barrier system
Fit self-closing, self-latching gates and compatible hardware
Repair panels, posts or gates after assessing the complete barrier
customerInfo: Pool-area photos and a sketch of the full barrier line
Measurements, ground levels and gate locations
Existing compliance information and nearby climbable features
canonicalServices.safetyNote: Pool barriers are safety-critical and must satisfy the requirements applying to the property and jurisdiction; keep the pool area secured while any defect remains.
canonicalServices.nextStep: Send full-perimeter photos, dimensions and gate details for a pool-fence assessment.

canonicalServices.title: Pool Resurfacing
canonicalServices.summary: Pool resurfacing renews a deteriorated interior finish after the shell, leaks, equipment interfaces and chosen coating system are assessed.
commonTasks: Inspect the pool surface for delamination, staining and cracking
Prepare the shell for a compatible render, pebble or coating system
Apply the selected finish and coordinate curing and refill requirements
customerInfo: Pool dimensions, construction type and approximate age
Photos of staining, cracks, loose areas and fittings
Water-loss history, previous coatings and access for equipment
canonicalServices.safetyNote: Draining a pool can affect shell stability and must be planned by experienced providers; chemicals and confined work areas require controlled handling.
canonicalServices.nextStep: Share pool dimensions, finish photos and leak history to start a resurfacing assessment.

canonicalServices.title: Surveyors
canonicalServices.summary: Surveying services provide measured site and boundary information for property, design and construction decisions.
commonTasks: Undertake a feature and level survey for design inputs
Locate or re-establish boundaries where the requested survey permits
Set out approved construction points or prepare relevant survey documentation
customerInfo: Property address, title details and purpose of the survey
Plans, previous surveys or design documents available
Required deliverable, project stage and site-access constraints
canonicalServices.safetyNote: Boundary and cadastral work must be completed by appropriately registered or licensed surveyors where required; site hazards must be disclosed before attendance.
canonicalServices.nextStep: Provide the address, survey purpose and available plans so Ellis can route the request to the appropriate surveying discipline.

canonicalServices.title: Synthetic Grass
canonicalServices.summary: Synthetic-grass services cover preparation and installation for lawns, courtyards, play spaces or other suitable outdoor areas.
commonTasks: Excavate and prepare a stable, free-draining base
Cut, join and secure the chosen synthetic turf system
Detail edges, penetrations and infill for the intended use
customerInfo: Area dimensions, shape and intended use
Photos of current surface, drainage and access
Preferred pile, colour and pet or heat considerations
canonicalServices.safetyNote: Poor drainage, heat exposure and unknown underground services should be resolved in the design before excavation and installation.
canonicalServices.nextStep: Send dimensions, site photos and intended use for a synthetic-grass installation scope.

canonicalServices.title: Timber Fencing
canonicalServices.summary: Timber fencing services cover paling, picket and screening fences, including new runs, damaged sections and gates.
commonTasks: Install posts, rails and timber boards to the agreed fence style
Replace rotted or storm-damaged sections after checking the support
Build or adjust compatible timber gates and screening panels
customerInfo: Fence length, height, style and timber preference
Photos of posts, slopes, access and adjoining structures
Boundary information and whether removal of an old fence is needed
canonicalServices.safetyNote: Boundaries, underground services, treated-timber handling and any retaining function need to be considered before digging or replacement.
canonicalServices.nextStep: Share fence-line photos and measurements to scope the timber materials and site work.

canonicalServices.title: Tree Arborists
canonicalServices.summary: Arborist services address tree health, risk, pruning and removal decisions where tree size, condition or location needs specialist knowledge.
commonTasks: Assess tree health, defects and risks to people or property
Prune trees using species-appropriate and structurally sound methods
Plan tree removal, stump handling or clearance where assessment supports it
customerInfo: Photos of the entire tree, trunk base, canopy and nearby targets
Approximate height, species if known and recent changes or damage
Access for equipment, overhead services and any council information
canonicalServices.safetyNote: Do not climb, cut or work beneath unstable branches. Large trees, chainsaws, rigging, powerlines and protected vegetation require qualified arborists, controlled exclusion zones and any necessary approvals.
canonicalServices.nextStep: Keep clear of suspect limbs and send whole-tree photos, location and concerns for arborist triage.

canonicalServices.title: Bathroom
canonicalServices.summary: Bathroom projects may combine layout changes, fixtures, tiling, waterproofing, cabinetry and coordinated licensed trades.
commonTasks: Develop a scope for a full renovation or targeted bathroom upgrade
Coordinate demolition, substrate preparation, waterproofing and finishes
Install selected fixtures, cabinetry and accessories through suitable trades
customerInfo: Room dimensions, photos and the desired layout
Fixture selections, budget priorities and current plumbing locations
Leak history, ventilation, access and any drawings or approvals
canonicalServices.safetyNote: Electrical, plumbing and waterproofing components may require appropriately licensed or qualified providers; active leaks and suspect materials need assessment before demolition.
canonicalServices.nextStep: Share room measurements, inspiration and must-keep items so Ellis can shape the bathroom project scope.

canonicalServices.title: Bricklayers
canonicalServices.summary: Bricklaying services cover new walls, localised rebuilding, damaged masonry and matching work around homes and outdoor areas.
commonTasks: Build scoped brick or block walls and piers
Rebuild loose, cracked or weather-damaged masonry sections
Match brick bond, joint profile and mortar colour where practical
customerInfo: Wall dimensions, purpose and photos from both sides
Brick type or matching stock, if available
Crack history, footings, drainage and nearby openings
canonicalServices.safetyNote: Cracking, leaning walls and load-bearing masonry may need structural assessment; excavation and boundary work can require approvals and service checks.
canonicalServices.nextStep: Send wall photos, dimensions and crack history for a brickwork assessment.

canonicalServices.title: Builders & Renovation Builders
canonicalServices.summary: Building and renovation services coordinate multi-trade projects, additions and substantial alterations from defined scope through delivery.
commonTasks: Develop a detailed build scope from plans or an initial brief
Coordinate sequencing across structural work, services and finishes
Deliver approved renovation or addition works with required project controls
customerInfo: Property address, project goals and target rooms or footprint
Plans, engineering, approvals and selections already available
